code: precinct_counts <- tibble(   precinct = c("77", "78", "88"),   n = c(1200, 950, 700) )  nyc_xwalk("pp", "cd") |>   inner_join(precinct_counts, by = c("primary_geo_name" = "precinct")) |>   mutate(     weight = intersection_area_sqft / sum(intersection_area_sqft),     .by = primary_geo_name   ) |>   summarise(n = sum(n * weight), .by = other_geo_name) |>   arrange(desc(n)) #> # A tibble: 5 × 2 #>   other_geo_name          n #>   <chr>               <dbl> #> 1 308            1241.      #> 2 302             718.      #> 3 306             527.      #> 4 355             364.      #> 5 307               0.00731

title: Geographic Crosswalks for New York City Boundaries
text: Dissolving: nycbuildxwalks combines features name computes overlaps. De-noising: nycbuildxwalks shrinks primary feature 50 feet (negative buffer) intersects features. drops overlaps 100 square feet less. Thus two directions pair (example, CD--NTA NTA--CD) can differ slightly. Narrow features: five narrow features (one BID four small historic districts) survive buffer. appear features. ZIP codes DOHMH Modified ZIP Code Tabulation Areas (MODZCTAs), USPS ZIP codes. Areas: nycbuildxwalks computes areas EPSG:2263 (NY State Plane, US feet).
